import pytest
from unittest.mock import patch
from myapp.chemist import Chemist
from myapp.lab import Lab
from myapp.patient import Patient
from myapp.admin import Admin
from myapp.database import Database

# Test Case 1: Prescription received by patient, chemist, and lab
@pytest.mark.test_case
@pytest.mark.skipif
def test_prescription_reception(chemist_mock, lab_mock):
    chemist_mock.receive_prescription = MagicMock(return_value=True)
    lab_mock.receive_prescription = MagicMock(return_value=True)
    
    patient = Patient()
    chemist = Chemist()
    lab = Lab()
    
    chemist.receive_prescription(patient.prescription)
    lab.receive_prescription(patient.prescription)
    
    chemist_mock.receive_prescription.assert_called_once_with(patient.prescription)
    lab_mock.receive_prescription.assert_called_once_with(patient.prescription)

# Test Case 2: Chemist provides medicines to the patient via offline delivery
@pytest.mark.test_case
def test_offline_delivery(chemist_mock):
    chemist_mock.deliver_medicine = MagicMock(return_value=True)
    
    patient = Patient()
    chemist = Chemist()
    
    chemist.deliver_medicine(patient, "medicine_id")
    
    chemist_mock.deliver_medicine.assert_called_once_with(patient, "medicine_id")

# Test Case 3: Lab uses prescription to collect specimen and make delivery of lab reports
@pytestzyme.mark.test_case
def test_lab_report_delivery(lab_mock, patient_mock):
    lab_mock.collect_specimen = MagicMock(return_value=True)
    lab_mock.generate_report = MagicMock(return_value=True)
    lab_mock.update_system_view = MagicMock(return_value=True)
    
    patient = Patient()
    lab = Lab()
    
    lab.collect_specimen(patient.prescription)
    lab.generate_report(patient.prescription)
    lab.update_system_view(patient)
    
    lab_mock.collect_specimen.assert_called_once_with(patient.prescription)
    lab_mock.generate_report.assert_called_once_with(patient.prescription)
    lab_mock.update_system_view.assert_called_once_with(patient)

# Test Case 4: Confidentiality of information for chemists and labs
@pytest.mark.test_case
def test_confidentiality(chemist_mock, lab_mock):
    with patch('myapp.chemist.Chemist.display_info', side_effect=Exception("Access Denied")):
        chemist_mock.display_info("patient_id")
    
    with patch('myapp.lab.Lab.display_info', side_effect=Exception("Access Denied")):
        lab_mock.display_info("patient_id")

# Test Case 5: Admin populates speciality database
@pytest.mark.test_case
def test_admin_speciality_database_population(admin_mock):
    admin_mock.populate_speciality_database()
    
    admin_mock.populate_speciality_database()

# Test Case 6: Admin links specialities to doctors and populates doctor database
@pytest.mark.test_case
def test_admin_doctor_database_population(admin_mock):
    admin_mock.link_specialities_to_doctors()
    admin_mock.populate_doctor_database()

# Test Case 7: Admin uses lab and chemist info to populate databases
@pytest.mark.test_case
def test_admin_database_population(admin_mock, chemist_mock, lab_mock):
    admin_mock.populate_databases(chemist_mock, lab_mock)

    admin_mock.populate_databases(chemist_mock, lab_mock)

    chemist_mock.display_info.assert_not_called()
    lab_mock.display_info.assert_not_called()

# Test Case 8: Patient registers into the system
@pytest.mark.test_case
def test_patient_registration(patient_mock):
    patient_mock.register()
    
    patient_mock.register()
